items.title: Bitcoin ETFs attract $1.08 billion in 3 days but it may not be enough for a steep rally
items.summary: Past steep rallies ran on about $235 million a day of net inflows into ETFs.

items.title: Matter Labs Introduces Prividium Commander for Existing Blockchains
items.summary: Institutions can add application permissions without moving to Prividium Ledger, while retaining their existing custody and signing providers.

items.title: PHP Foundation admits ‘structural failure’ delayed critical security fix
items.summary: Government websites and online services were disrupted after concerns about a PHP bug that could allow attackers to take control of vulnerable servers.

items.title: Aerodrome and Velodrome merge to launch Aero across seven blockchain networks
items.summary: Aerodrome and Velodrome have merged to launch Aero across Ethereum mainnet, Base, Robinhood Chain, Ink, OP Mainnet, Arc, and Arbitrum.
